notes.title: Play Transport INC wherever you are!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

As you might have noticed, there was a lot of updates recently. That's because we were working hard on the mobile version of the Transport INC, and while testing the game and collecting feedback, we have received a lot of valuable data that we have considered worth implementing in the PC version of the game as well. You could read about most of those changes in the recent Regular Update announcement, and the latest changes were just minor improvements and fixes added to the game. 

[h2]Transport INC Mobile[/h2]

You have read that right - [b]Transport INC is available on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.DigiFox.TransportInc]Google Play[/url] starting today[/b]! The game has a new UI dedicated to mobile devices and all the latest improvements, including the new [b]Weekly Challenge[/b] game mode. If you are up for some competition, now is the best time to give this new game mode a chance and compete with other players! iOS version is about to come on a later date, so if you're interested in obtaining the game in the App Store, we will be thankful for giving us a little bit more time. 

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.DigiFox.TransportInc][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35070144/db72cd8f75ba828b38d5d9bfcafe64c1b2ad3b63.png[/img][/url]

[h2]More good news about to come![/h2]

We have released this game 19 months ago. A lot of hard work has been done by the whole team. During that time we have added new translations, new game modes, new maps, and countless balance updates, to make the game more fun for you to play. But what if we have tried adding something truly new to the game? What if we have added a completely new layer of gameplay? Can you see a... [b]Sea of opportunities[/b]? But for now, it's all still a secret! We will give you more information, as we progress with our work! 

A quick reminder - we are also working hard on our newest game, [b]Delivery INC[/b]. If you want to receive instant notifications about any updates we might have for the game, don't forget to wishlist and follow it on Steam. If you're a fan of transport-related simulation games, Delivery INC is absolutely worth checking! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1793260/Delivery_INC/

Happy transporting and stay safe! 
DIGIFOX Team

notes.title: Transport INC v1.3.5 - Update
notes.content:
Happy Lunar New Year from the Transport INC team! We are celebrating by releasing a small game update along with a 40% off sale!
In this update, we are wanting to give our players the option of controlling randomness by introducing seed selection. You can now set the game’s random seed before playing the freeplay and global race game modes. Being able to set the random seed will allow players to find interesting games and replay them multiple times.
We know that players will want to share game seeds, so we are starting a new #seeds channel on our Discord. Be sure to join and share any seeds in this channel that you find fun or excitingly difficult!
Transport INC is also playable in a new language! To celebrate the holiday, we are releasing the Traditional Chinese language as an option. The Transport INC community has done an amazing job helping us translate the game to several languages and we can’t thank them enough!
A full list of changes for this update can be found below. We hope that you get a chance to relax this Lunar New Year with Transport INC.


Change Log v1.3.5: 
[list]
[*] New language - Traditional Chinese (beta)
[*] New language - Brazilian Portuguese (beta)
[*] Players can now set the random seed for freeplay and global race game modes
[*] Balancing improvements to story mode
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

Stay safe!

Team

notes.title: Holiday Update (Stocks and Leaderboards)
notes.content:
Transport INC version 1.3 is now out of beta and available to the public, just in time for the holidays. To celebrate this big holiday update, Transport INC will be 35% off for a limited time! If you do not own the game already, or you would like to surprise a friend with a holiday gift, now is the perfect time. This update includes many great new and improved features you can enjoy over your holiday break.

The buyout mechanic has been improved by introducing stocks. Companies now battle it out in the stock market to keep control of their company. If a company loses all ten of their stocks, they become in danger of being bought out!
Learn all about the stocks feature and more in the new in game wiki. This helpful tool is used to find information about different game mechanics. Each mechanic in the wiki is explained with text and pictures.
Story Mode has also been updated. New and improved tutorials have been added as well as leaderboards for each chapter. You can now compete against other companies all over the world to see who can beat each chapter the fastest. So even if you are a veteran player, there is something new waiting for you in Story Mode.

The Transport INC community has been beyond generous in helping us translate all of these new features to over 10 different languages! But not all languages have been fully translated. If you would like to help with translations or just want to get the latest updates and chances for early access to updates, consider joining our [url=https://discord.gg/D7hZbNNNFg]Discord[/url] server.

Many other quality of life fixes, updates, and improvements can be found in the full release notes below.

Happy transporting and happy holidays!

-Team

[h2]Change log:[/h2]
[h3]Limited Time Holiday Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Santa LTD to Story Mode
[/list]
[h3]Major Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The buyout mechanic has been massively improved to include stocks. This means that competitors now have the option to buy the player’s company and other opponent’s companies by purchasing enough stocks. Once a company is purchased, you can perform special actions with their vehicles, use their depots, and take a custom revenue share of their monthly profits.
[*] Added an in game wiki menu. This menu will let you explore many important game mechanics. Each mechanic will be explained with text and images.
[*] Added Leaderboards for each difficulty to all Story Mode chapters. You can now compete against other companies to complete the chapter the fastest.
[*] Updated layering structure to fix many layering issues
[*] Fixed an exploit where players could use managers for free
[*] Managers no longer perform full repairs for you. This action has been moved to subsidiaries
[*] Added a tutorial to Story Mode Chapter 9 explaining how to purchase stocks and buyout a company
[*] Added a tutorial to Story Mode Chapter 10 explaining how to purchase and use subsidiaries
[/list]
[h3]Minor Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some hints not showing
[*] Fixed issues with missing text or text not properly displaying
[*] Fixed minor graphical issues and made minor graphical improvements
[*] Made improvements and fixes to in game wiki
[*] Moved company name change to main menu. This company name will carry over to all game modes
[*] Completion of story mode missions are now permanently marked as completed. Missions can no longer switch back to incomplete if the condition is no longer met
[*] Disabled specific HUD menus and actions in certain story mode chapters for a better player experience
[*] Story mode chapters now include mission charts at the end of each chapter
[*] Fixed an issue in the Chapter 4 manager tutorial where the tutorial would sometimes not function properly
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 driver strike tutorial where the tutorial sometimes would not start
[*] Adjusted how the Chapter 5 license tutorial was activated
[*] Updated chapter 8 goal. All missions must be completed in 5 years instead of only 4 years
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the tutorial window to get stuck on screen during the Chapter 9 stocks tutorial
[*] Fixed loading issue in Chapter 9 that made an empty tutorial window appear on screen
[*] Fixed other minor Story Mode tutorial issues
[*] Detour button now flashes in bottom right menu for vehicles when they are faced with a situation that needs a detour
[*] Improved AI behavior with stocks
[*] Added the ability to customize revshare earned from purchased companies
[*] Fixed issues with performing special actions with purchased companies vehicles
[*] If a competitors vehicle menu is open during a buyout, the menu now updates properly
[*] Fixed an issue where players could perform a buyout on a company they owned no stocks in
[*] Adjusted color of blue opponent and stocks for better visibility
[*] Added PEACE TIME in free play settings. This can alter how many months all companies must wait before they can start purchasing stocks. The default Peace Time is set to “off” (zero months)
[*] Lowered price for additional cargo upgrade for the delivery van
[*] Made active vehicle upgrades visible in vehicles menu
[*] Added the ability to adjust the max wait time for a vehicle before departing in vehicle menus. This fixes an issue where vehicles sometimes infinitely wait for max capacity before departing
[*] Vehicle names now update properly when they are changed
[*] Vehicle name numbering now increases properly. Two vehicles can not have the same number
[*] Updated graphics for currently selected vehicles. The current vehicle selected will now be clearly highlighted
[*] Altered the speed of how fast each vehicle condition degrades
[*] The “wait for obstacle to be removed” option can no longer be used on vehicles that are not currently facing an obstacle
[*] Fixed issue where ticket prices for other vehicles would change when adding a new vehicle to a route 
[*] Added logos for all companies. They are visible in the Companies Menu
[*] Fixed loading issue where company logos would appear as solid colored squares instead of logo images
[*] After building a route, the selected city no longer becomes unselected
[*] Added discord buttons to the main menu and default wiki page
[*] BETA tag added to all languages other than English to make players aware that some languages may not be fully translated
[*] Adjusted the way loans are calculated
[*] Fixed customer feedback glitch on hard mode
[*] Adjusted bankruptcy rules so players can not go bankrupt with a positive bank account balance
[*] Scroll bars have been added to scroll-able menus
[*] Driver payoff button now flashes red while drivers are on strike. This is to help communicate better to players that the drivers MUST be paid off to make them go back to work, as adjusting the salary is not enough. Drivers menu graphics have also been slightly altered to make the “driver payoff” easier to understand
[*] Updated Drivers salary demand behavior
[*] Fixed the auto-save function. The last five (5) auto-saves will now be kept rather than just one (1) auto-save file
[*] Updated graphics for performing dirty actions to opponents. The waiting process after performing a dirty action is shown differently now
[*] Fixed an issue where bankrupt opponents sometimes were not removed from the top right info panel
[*] The Taiwan region now also comes with the Fujian region, and vice versa
[/list]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE ENTERING BETA TODAY
notes.content:
Many requested improvements to Transport INC are entering beta today! To access the beta, simply join our [url=https://discord.gg/yMFKq3r]Discord[/url] server and follow the pinned instructions! Thanks to player feedback, we were able to identify and fix many issues. We were also able to make changes to many existing mechanics to improve the Transport INC experience.

The main mechanic we are focused on improving with this update is the buyout mechanic. The process of making an offer on a company and waiting for their reply was uneventful. That has all changed now with stocks!

Check out a detailed explanation of how stocks and the improved buyout mechanic work in our new in game Wiki! Many important game mechanics are explained in detail with pictures and text.

This change makes the process of a buyout much more engaging and gives our players new important decisions to make. The new wiki will help all players understand the game’s mechanics and refresh their memory when needed. We hope you all enjoy it and are looking forward to the feedback!

We are excited to share this new update with the community. This update will be leaving beta soon, so be sure to join us in making this update even better!

Stay safe!
-Team

notes.title: DEVELOPMENT UPDATE
notes.content:
The list of improvements that are coming just keeps getting longer!

Our main focus for this update is to polish, fix bugs, and improve existing mechanics. Before we add anymore new features to the game, we want to make sure our existing ones are the best that they can be.
As we briefly mentioned in our last update, we are improving the way buying out a company works by introducing stocks! Rather than simply making an offer and waiting for an answer, we are making the process far more interesting. You will not be the only one buying out companies, a competitor can now buyout your company as well!

All companies will start with 10 stocks each. Purchasing a stock from a company will give you a slight ownership of that company. If a company loses all of their stocks, they will be in danger of being bought out. They must defend by quickly buying back their stocks from competitors. If they do not act fast enough, they will be purchased and forced to merge with their new owners.
Changing up the buyout option this way adds new strategies, decisions, and depth to the game. We can’t wait to share it!

The hint system is also getting an improvement. We are reworking this to include a full in-game wiki where you can easily look up all the info you need, when you need it. Features and mechanics will be neatly organized and explained with pictures and text. The wiki will also include the requested option to disable hints!

Other improvements include drivers salary demands and strike behaviors are being tweaked, several visual issues are being addressed, menus will now include scrollbars, and more!  
We have been working closely with our community to polish the game where it needs it the most. All of your bug reports and feedback are looked over daily. We appreciate and read every email. If you are not already a part of our community, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/yMFKq3r]Discord[/url] and help us make Transport INC the best it can be.

The beta will be arriving soon! Be sure to hop on board!

Stay safe!
-Team

notes.title: TRANSPORT HUBS AND MORE LANGUAGE OPTIONS ARE OUT NOW
notes.content:
Transport Hubs are out of Beta and now accessible to all players. With Transport Hubs, you can have your passengers reach places they couldn’t before and take advantage of multiple vehicles during a single trip.

Need to get to an island, but there is no airport in the city? Build a hub in a neighboring city with an airport! You can travel to the hub on a bus or train, then take a plane to the island! Trains are not an option in all cities, but now with hubs they are! Travel by bus to a hub with a railroad and then switch your customers over to a train to speed up their journey and keep them happy.

Transport Hubs are not just for passengers. They can be used on cargo as well. Fly cargo into a hub on an island and then distribute those goods with trucks to neighboring cities.

We want to make sure that Transport INC can be played and enjoyed all over the world, so we have added support for 5 more languages! Czech, Slovak, Dutch, Portuguese and Italian have all been added. Be sure to change the game to your native language in the options menu.

We hope you all enjoy this new exciting layer of transportation. Let us know what you think of this new feature or if you have a request for a language that is not yet available. We are always listening and interacting with our players on our [url=https://discord.gg/yMFKq3r]Discord server[/url].

Stay Safe!

Team

notes.content:

[url=https://forms.gle/hgADm5UKZnhp9PZE8]Form[/url]

Your passengers will need help reaching their final destination using multiple different vehicles. Using Hubs, you can achieve new ways to transport! notes.title: SUBSIDIARIES UPDATE IS OUT!
notes.content:
For the last few weeks, we have been teasing a new Transport INC update. Today, that update has arrived! Say hello to subsidiaries, a new way to manage your vehicles.

A subsidiary is a new company that you can make during gameplay. This new company, owned by you, will manage and upkeep vehicles in chosen territories. After creating your subsidiary, it is your job to analyze the territory the subsidiary is responsible for and provide the vehicles it needs to transport passengers. Supply the right vehicles and you will rake in the profits from your satisfied customers.
This new feature will lower the amount of micromanaging required with each expansion of your company. As you expand into new territories, you can build subsidiaries to upkeep previous territories so you can focus on your new one.
Come check out the new update now and let us know what you think of subsidiaries!

We are interested to hear your thoughts and feedback. Please click the following link and fill out the form. This will greatly help us shape the future of Transport INC. By filling out the form, you will also be entered into a chance of winning a free game from the Games Operators franchise.
[url=https://forms.gle/Yy472Vw99yrSRF566]FORM[/url]

Plenty of your feedback made it to the game too:
[list]
[*]When a vehicle is in a depot for repair can it please still be listed against it's route. It will nearly always be reassigned to he route anyway, especially with a manager so having an inaccurate/incomplete count on the routes list is very confusing.
[*]Also, when you have many icons on screen, it's hard to see behind everything.  But when you use the eye to make them disappear, you don't see any of their stats.  It'd be nice to click on a vehicle circle when the "eye" button is activated, then a small window shows up that shows the current stats of that vehicle.  otherwise the only way to see the stats is to unclick the eye, making everything visible again
[*]Allow adjusting scrolling speed 
[*]Make it possible to create routes from city window directly
[*]Why isn't there a hotkey to open the shop? I can't see it in the menu anyway. I feel it'd be one of my most used hotkeys
[*]Have some way to bring the problem vehicle (causing the red flashing) to the top of the list so you don't have to scroll through it
[*]It would be nice to have a list of idle or empty vehicles so you know if something needs tweaking because scanning the world map late game for that is impossible
[*]Could we have a way to change our company name within the same save
[*]Assign each vehicle a unique ID, just a number would do, which would make it easier to locate the one you want within the route and vehicle lists.
[*]I think small popups should have dark background. same, as in left top
[*]We can sort the vehicles list, I would also like to be able to sort the routes list, at least by profitability and name.
[*]So each new game I have to reset the name, difficulty, win conditions, vehicle limit, number of opponents and then think about where I want to lay routes. In many other games those things stick from playthrough to playthrough.
[/list]
And more...

Stay safe!
Team

notes.title: Transport INC- Closed Beta Update (v0.9.0)

Our team has been listening to player feedback and making many changes to Transport INC over the last several weeks. A handful of important fixes have made their way into the game and we are delighted to share them with you today. Be sure to update and give the new version a try!

FIXES
[list]
[*] [b]Story AI[/b] - We have added challenging opponents into a story mode. Lets see who's better!
[*] [b]Improved AI[/b] - Opponent behaviour had a major rework. Competitors are more challenging and make better decisions faster.
[*] [b]More Dynamic Economy[/b] - City travel demands have been rebalanced and change during gameplay more frequently. This means players will have to adapt and adjust routes more often. Many purchase prices have also been adjusted. All of this improves the strategic gameplay.
[*] [b]Removed Time Limit On Free Play Mode[/b] - Play this mode as long as you want with no time restriction.
[*] [b]Auto Assign Managers[/b] - The managers tab now has an option to have vehicles automatically assigned to managers.
[*] [b]Minor and Major Bug Fixes[/b] - Several issues reported by players have been fixed
[/list]

We hope you find all of these improvements just as enjoyable as we do. If you currently do not have Beta access, there is still a chance to get a Beta key. Simply fill out the form linked below and keep an eye on your inbox!

notes.title: Transport INC AMA
notes.content:
[h2]All aboard![/h2]

[h3]Ask us anything about Transport INC![/h3]
Join us on Discord in our #SteamGameFestivalAMA channel to ask us anything about our upcoming game Transport INC. We are excited to hear from you and answer your questions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35070144/c7a8ada83dc50bd80c686c66cd274c1e2c9a474b.gif[/img]
[h3]About the game[/h3]
Transport INC is an in-depth simulation of the transportation industry and what it takes to 
manage your own company. Use different types of vehicles to transport cargo, passengers, and more across real world maps while competing with other companies to be the best in the business.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35070144/cf61b0848f1758a830a316d27f62ab90e5124c67.gif[/img]
[h3]Key features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Manage Vehicles: Purchase, repair, and plan routes for many different vehicles types. Start with busses and work your way up to other forms of transportation, such as trains and airplanes. Be sure to maintain your vehicles regularly or hire someone to do it for you. Keep track of customer demands so you can supply the speed and comfort they need for their travels.
[*] Set Prices: Fully customize your ticket prices for economy class, first class, and cargo. Make your prices competitive to steal customers from other businesses. Keep your profits steady by adapting to customer demands and city events.
[*] Take Actions: Make quick decisions and adapt to the world's challenges. Reroute during road closures, increase capacity for sporting events, make changes to keep up with demands, and more. Sabotage your competitors when the opportunity arises by closing roads, damaging vehicles, and other dirty tricks.
[/list]

notes.title: Transport INC Festival Developer Stream
notes.content:
[h2]All aboard![/h2]

[h3]Watch Transport INC stream![/h3]
The Digifox team is bringing the transportation business simulator to life with Transport INC. Join us as we play through the game and answer your questions live in chat and on our Discord.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35070144/cf61b0848f1758a830a316d27f62ab90e5124c67.gif[/img]
[h3]About the game[/h3]
Transport INC is an in-depth simulation of the transportation industry and what it takes to 
manage your own company. Use different types of vehicles to transport cargo, passengers, and more across real world maps while competing with other companies to be the best in the business.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35070144/c7a8ada83dc50bd80c686c66cd274c1e2c9a474b.gif[/img]
[h3]Key features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Manage Vehicles: Purchase, repair, and plan routes for many different vehicles types. Start with busses and work your way up to other forms of transportation, such as trains and airplanes. Be sure to maintain your vehicles regularly or hire someone to do it for you. Keep track of customer demands so you can supply the speed and comfort they need for their travels.
[*] Set Prices: Fully customize your ticket prices for economy class, first class, and cargo. Make your prices competitive to steal customers from other businesses. Keep your profits steady by adapting to customer demands and city events.
[*] Take Actions: Make quick decisions and adapt to the world's challenges. Reroute during road closures, increase capacity for sporting events, make changes to keep up with demands, and more. Sabotage your competitors when the opportunity arises by closing roads, damaging vehicles, and other dirty tricks.
[/list]
